system.name: Shield
system.description:
This spell creates a magical barrier an inch away from the caster's body that shields the caster from harm. While this spell is in effect, the caster has an armour class of 2 against missile attacks and an armour class of 4 against all other attacks rather than their normal armour class. Dexterity and magical bonuses apply to this armour class as normal, but worn armour does not change it.

This spell also grants the caster a spell save each time they would be hit by the missile from a Magic Missile spell. If the save fails, the missile hits the caster normally. If the save succeeds, the missiles are blocked, but this spell is ends immediately.

When cast by an immortal, this spell gives the caster a –4 AC bonus against missile attacks and a –2 AC bonus against other attacks.
